<subject>Re: Monkey Business</subject>
<body>
I'm an expert at being a rabid fan and excellent armchair manager. I keep waiting for the Perth Wildcats to call for advice....

-----Original Message-----
From: Devin King <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au>
Sent: Friday, 29 March 2024 4:28 PM
To: Adam Costa <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>
Subject: Re: Monkey Business

Sorry for the late notice - have been underwater this week trying to get the Port Hedland and Roy Hill projects buttoned up, and just realized today that I needed to get on this. Will hope to see you there and try to find another time we can go. My understanding from all is that you are the resident footy expert (next to Robert Stanley).

Best regards.

cgt
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Adam Costa <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>
Sent: Friday, 29 March 2024 4:12 PM
To: Devin King <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au>
Subject: Re: Monkey Business

I would love to take you up on it, but I'm already lined up to go. I'll take a raincheck!

Thanks for thinking of me.

Adam

-----Original Message-----
From: Devin King <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au>
Sent: Friday, 29 March 2024 4:07 PM
To: Margaret Cox <margaret.cox@tasmanridge.com.au>; Adam Costa <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>; Eric Moore <eric.moore@tasmanridge.com.au>
Subject: Monkey Business

My recollection is that each of you is somewhat of a footy fan, as I am. I just happen to have 4 great seats for the Opening Round at Optus Stadium, for which I very much need company to help me enjoy. I would love it if each of you could join me. The game starts at 4:05 pm, so it might require leaving the office a little early. But of course we would be discussing serious business the entire time so that it would be fully justifiable to anyone interested. I will bring my legal pad to take notes.

Let me know. Hope you can come.

cgt
